description: This file defines the CachingSiloAddressCodec class, which provides serialization and deserialization for SiloAddress objects with caching mechanisms to optimize performance and reduce memory allocations. It includes methods for reading and writing raw SiloAddress data, cache management, and internal helper functions.

classes.name: CachingSiloAddressCodec
classes.description: A serializer for SiloAddress that caches values to avoid re-encoding and unnecessary allocations, with internal cache management and helper methods.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads a raw SiloAddress from the provided reader, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: PurgeStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes cache entries that haven't been accessed within the specified purge interval.

methods.name: ReadSiloAddressInner
methods.description: Deserializes a SiloAddress from the reader, reading IP, port, and generation.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes a SiloAddress to the writer, utilizing cache to prevent redundant serialization.

methods.name: WriteSiloAddressInner
methods.description: Serializes the inner components of a SiloAddress, including IP, port, and generation.
